name: What types of home additions typically require a permit in Los Angeles County?

mainEntity.name: What types of home additions typically require a permit in Los Angeles County?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Los Angeles County, most home additions that involve structural changes, increasing square footage, or altering utility systems will require a permit. This commonly includes new bedrooms, bathrooms, family rooms, second-story additions, garage conversions that add living space, and significant deck constructions. Minor interior cosmetic remodels that don't affect load-bearing walls or plumbing/electrical are often exempt. It's always best to consult with a professional builder or your local planning department to confirm specific requirements for your project.
